description: List the counties and comparable administrative areas of a state, including nullable ISO 3166-2 iso_code on each item. Paid plans include population in each result automatically.

code.description: State code or name, e.g. NC, colorado

country.description: ISO2, ISO3, or a country name. Optional when the lookup is unique.

deep.description: Include population in each county on a paid plan.

lang.description: Optional display language, such as fr or zh-Hant. IDs, numeric values and input parsing stay unchanged.

name: state_counties
title: State Counties
